title: Fractional Support Rings and Upgrade Cadence Matrix for Private/VPC Licenses
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and validate a new fractional support offering ("support rings") for Private/VPC and on-prem licensing that allows enterprise customers to purchase graduated support coverage by % of peak capacity, plus an upgrade cadence matrix that ties entitlements to maintenance windows, permitted upgrade frequency, and optional hotfix SLAs. This ticket covers packaging options, suggested list pricing bands, legal checklist for contract language, a draft security questionnaire response template, and a small pilot with two existing customers.
acceptance_criteria: Draft pricing table with at least three fractional support rings (Bronze/30%, Silver/60%, Gold/100%) with suggested list prices and unit economics rationale
Upgrade cadence matrix that maps entitlement tier to allowed upgrade frequency (monthly/quarterly/biannual) and documented rollback/backport policy
Legal-approved contract clause templates for fractional entitlements and credit calculations for missed SLAs
Completed security questionnaire template for Private/VPC (answers + references to KMS, audit logs, network isolation) for inclusion in RFx responses
Pilot plan and success metrics agreed with two pilot customers; kickoff scheduled by 2026-03-15

notes: Design constraint: packaging must map cleanly to Dedicated offerings so customers can convert from fractional ring to full reserved capacity without re-contracting.
Operational note: rollout requires console UI to express percent-coverage and maintenance window preferences (UX ticket to follow).
Risk: customers may treat fractional SLAs as ambiguous; mitigate via examples in contract and an automated credits calculator in billing portal.
